text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To be exact, we'll find our answer if we do
laps around the deck! 1.6
laps to the right,
then 2.4 laps to the left, and finally 2 laps
to the
right!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The key hint came from Fine—the info on
the hotel's guide map! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't really get it, but basically we
just have to go in circles,
right? C'mon
Rice, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ah—Urara, we're supposed to go
right first!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rice, Urara, be careful not to trip and
injure yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let us leave finding the item to those two.
Personally, I'm more
curious to know how
you solved the riddle.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to hear your thought process as
well. We had just agreed that
"travel
towards the queen's summit" referred to
the path of the Triple
Tiara, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup. But since this is a riddle, there's no
way they actually want us to
run through
each racecourse in person.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's when I remembered what Fine told
us in the room...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I haven't, but I was shown the guide map
when we arrived earlier. It's
standard
protocol between my security and me to
prepare for
emergencies.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now if I recall, the map stated, "With an
outer perimeter of 100
meters, our
250-meter tall observation deck provides
a 360-degree
panoramic view of the city!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I remember finding it interesting that the
observation deck was
exactly 100 meters
around. And then, when we read the
riddle, that
same 100 was there again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Up in a gallery heaven-high, 10 becomes
1, and 100 becomes 10."
In other words,
we divide all the measurements of this
observation
deck by 10.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then I thought, what if we divided the
distances of all three Triple
Tiara races by
10, and then walked laps based on the
running
direction of each racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see, so the Oka Sho's 1,600 meters
becomes 160 meters, and since
it takes
place at the right-handed Hanshin
Racecourse, we just need
to go to the
right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We've been going round and round,
but there's nothing here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what should we do? Did we mess up
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. They look like they could use
some help.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You two, from what I've seen, you didn't
go far enough to the left
earlier. Let's try
again from the start, together this time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, Ikuno's always looking out for
others. I can't get enough of that
cute side
of hers! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we can always rely on her.
...Curren, do you mind answering
another
question of mine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Why did you not stop those three?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Curren, you told me that you wished to take this audition seriously, yes?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If I want to get my hands on the universe's
cutest racewear, then I
couldn't ask for a
better team, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Faced with a time limit and fierce
competition from rival teams, you
chose to
forgo efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Instead of having them travel in circles to
find the item, you could
have simply told
them its location from the start. I find that
strange.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's because I want the cutest
racewear ever.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "The cutest racewear ever?" Do explain.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup! ♪ It's true that if I only cared about
efficiency, then I should've
just told them
where to look for the item.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But this is a team event, and in my eyes,
getting all worked up by
myself and
hogging the spotlight isn't cute at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even if we won like that, and I had a dress
made for me, I don't think
I'd look very
cute in it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So that's why... You've been thinking
about how Ms. Beauty views
your actions
as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Spot on. Besides, look over there...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Found it! We did it this time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What a relief... Now we can move on to the
next riddle.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Good work, you two. Let's put our heads
together and solve the next
riddle as well!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's "cute" in their own way... I just
thought it'd be a big shame
if they didn't
get to show their cuteness off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Um... What's this thingy for?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's a rather familiar design, but I can't
imagine what we'd use it for.
Maybe we'll
find out after we solve the second riddle?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The next one looks tough... Um, I'll read it
for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Lift your gaze to the room containing
every number, for treasure
hides where the
beholder lies. The legend begins on your
marks."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder where "on your marks" refers to?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, we can be safe in
assuming that this riddle's telling
us to find
a certain location, just like the last one...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Bonjour, this is Beauty Anshinzawa! I see
every team is making
splendid progress in
solving their riddles!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"But for now, I'm calling a quick break
time! ♪ Everyone, please
gather in the
main hall."
